title: STP Configuration
description: Configure root bridge priority, port costs, and verify spanning-tree operation.
scenario: Configure root bridge priority, port costs, and verify spanning-tree operation.

concepts.title: Root Bridge Configuration
concepts.body: Set a switch as root with "spanning-tree vlan 1 root primary". It automatically lowers the priority below the current root.

concepts.title: Manual Priority
concepts.body: Set priority manually with "spanning-tree vlan <id> priority". Values are multiples of 4096 (0, 4096, 8192 ... 61440).

concepts.title: Port Cost
concepts.body: A lower port cost makes a port the preferred path. Set it per interface with "spanning-tree cost".
concepts.code:
SW1(config-if)# spanning-tree cost 19
SW1(config-if)# spanning-tree cost 4

concepts.title: Verifying
concepts.body: "show spanning-tree root" confirms who is root. "show spanning-tree" shows ports, roles, and costs.
concepts.code:
SW1# show spanning-tree root
Root ID  Priority 32769, Address 00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5E
Root bridge is: SW1 (this switch)
